Indian consulates worldwide organise mass events, but the real infrastructure is the community yoga classes, temple sessions, and neighbourhood groups that have been running for decades. nri-world.title: You Moved Abroad and Forgot to Tell Your Bank. That's a FEMA Violation.

As India builds its own fabs in Dholera and Gujarat, the NVIDIA-TSMC playbook for AI-powered manufacturing is precisely the technology those facilities will need to be competitive.

technology.title: Lip-Bu Tan Told Computex That CPUs Are Back. Intel's 18A Chip Is His Opening Argument.
technology.excerpt: At Computex 2026, Intel's CEO unveiled the Xeon 6+ — the first server processor built on America's most advanced chipmaking process — and made a pointed case for why AI's next act belongs to the CPU.
technology.nri_angle: Intel's India engineering operation — one of its largest R&D centres globally, based in Bangalore — contributed to the 18A process development and Xeon design work. For the thousands of Indian engineers at Intel, the Xeon 6+ launch validates a multi-year bet. For NRI investors, Intel's stock has more than quintupled since Lip-Bu Tan took over.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Broadcom Reports Earnings Tonight With AI Revenue That Has Doubled in a Year. The Pressure Is Enormous.
technology.excerpt: Wall Street expects $22 billion in quarterly revenue and confirmation that custom AI silicon — not just Nvidia's GPUs — is the new centre of gravity in the $800 billion AI infrastructure build-out.
technology.nri_angle: Broadcom's India engineering centres in Bangalore and Hyderabad are critical to its custom ASIC design pipeline — the very products driving its AI revenue explosion. For NRI investors, Broadcom has quietly become one of the best-performing semiconductor stocks of 2026, and tonight's earnings will determine whether its $2.1 trillion valuation holds.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Anthropic Just Filed to Go Public at $965 Billion. It Beat OpenAI to the Punch.
technology.excerpt: The Claude AI maker submitted a confidential S-1 to the SEC, kicking off what could become the largest tech IPO in history — and the first shot in a three-way listing race with OpenAI and SpaceX.
technology.nri_angle: Indian AI researchers at Anthropic, OpenAI, and DeepMind helped build the models driving these trillion-dollar valuations. For NRI investors, the trio of AI IPOs this year represents the first chance to own shares in frontier AI labs — and the stakes for Indian-origin engineers holding equity at these companies are staggering.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: How Jensen Huang Convinced Sanjay Mehrotra to Abandon Frugality. Now Micron Is Worth a Trillion Dollars.
technology.excerpt: A private meeting three years ago between the Nvidia CEO and Micron's Indian-origin boss reshaped the memory chip industry. Micron's stock has risen tenfold since, and its first India fab just started producing chips.
technology.nri_angle: Sanjay Mehrotra, born in Kanpur, is the Indian-origin CEO who has led Micron to a $1 trillion valuation. Micron's Sanand, Gujarat facility — India's first semiconductor assembly and test plant — opened in February 2026 with a $2.75 billion investment. NRI investors holding MU stock have seen 200%+ returns in 2026 alone.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Samsung Workers Are Threatening a Nationwide Strike. The AI Chip Shortage Could Get Worse.
technology.excerpt: Samsung Electronics has begun cutting chip production ahead of a planned labour action. With memory supply already stretched beyond 2028, the timing could not be worse for the AI industry — or for Indian semiconductor professionals watching the supply chain.
technology.nri_angle: Indian semiconductor professionals work across the memory supply chain — at Micron's India fab, at Samsung and SK Hynix design centres, and at AI companies dependent on stable memory supply. A Samsung production disruption would tighten the market for Indian chip engineers and affect NRI investors with semiconductor exposure.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: Jensen Huang Just Told Marvell It Will Be the Next Trillion-Dollar Company. The Stock Jumped 32%.
technology.excerpt: At Computex 2026, the Nvidia CEO pointed to networking as the hidden bottleneck in AI infrastructure — and anointed Marvell as its solution. Indian engineers building the data centre stack should pay attention.
technology.nri_angle: Marvell employs significant Indian engineering talent in its Santa Clara operations and design centres. For NRI investors, the stock has quadrupled in 12 months. For Indian engineers at data centre companies, this signals that networking and optical interconnect roles are the next frontier of AI hiring.
technology.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: IMAX Is Coming Back to Hyderabad After a Decade. Mahesh Babu's AMB Cinemas Just Made It Official.

entertainment.title: Drishyam 3 Has Wrapped. Ajay Devgn's Version Promises a Very Different Film From the One Mohanlal Just Made.
entertainment.excerpt: Director Abhishek Pathak says the Hindi adaptation leans into family thriller territory, not the drama-heavy approach of the Malayalam original. October 2 is the date. Jaideep Ahlawat and Prakash Raj are the new additions.

entertainment.title: Jacqueline Fernandez Walked Into a Delhi Courtroom Today. The ₹200-Crore Trial She Spent Three Years Avoiding Has Begun.
entertainment.excerpt: The court found 'strong suspicion' she received ₹5.71 crore in gifts from a convicted conman and moved money to family accounts abroad. Her defense — that she was a victim — was rejected as meritless.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: AR Rahman Heard the Masoom Script and Asked to Co-Produce It. Forty-Three Years Later, Shekhar Kapur Is Going Back.
entertainment.excerpt: The original's stars return, migration becomes a central theme, and one song is already recorded. For the diaspora, this sequel was always personal.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Delhi High Court Orders Takedown of Varun Dhawan AI Deepfakes. The Ruling Names Every Technology That Can Steal a Face.
entertainment.excerpt: Justice Jyoti Singh's order explicitly targets generative AI, face-morphing, and chatbots — making it one of India's most specific personality rights rulings in the deepfake era.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Taylor Swift Wrote a Song for Toy Story 5. The Film Opens in India on June 19. Here's Why NRI Families Should Care.
entertainment.excerpt: The biggest pop star in the world meets the most beloved animated franchise. For Indian diaspora families raising kids between two cultures, this is the summer movie event that actually matters.

entertainment.excerpt: Not Suitable for Work premiered on Hulu this week with Avantika playing Abhinaya 'Abby' Chilukuri — a rare South Asian lead in a mainstream network comedy. Critics are divided. The audience hasn't decided yet.

entertainment.title: Ram Charan's Peddi Opens in America Before India. The Advance Numbers Suggest Telugu Cinema's Next Blockbuster Has Already Arrived.
entertainment.excerpt: With ₹40 crore in global pre-sales, 28,000 tickets sold across 533 US locations, and premiere shows starting tonight in North America, Peddi is tracking toward the $1 million premiere club that only a dozen Telugu films have ever entered.

entertainment.title: Vijay Became Chief Minister. His Last Film Is Still Waiting for a Release Date. The Story of Jana Nayagan Is Now Stranger Than Its Script.
entertainment.excerpt: A piracy leak that cost ₹103 crore, a censor fight that delayed the film by six months, and an election victory that turned a troubled production into the most anticipated cultural event in Tamil cinema. The diaspora is watching.

entertainment.excerpt: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups is set between the 1940s and the 1970s, stars five female leads, and opens opposite Peddi. It is either the boldest bet in Indian cinema this year or the most expensive one.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

entertainment.title: Bobby Deol Went to Jail for Anurag Kashyap. On Thursday, the Rest of the World Gets to Watch.
entertainment.excerpt: Bandar premiered at TIFF last September. Its Indian release, nine months later, brings a prison drama built on the bones of Paatal Lok's writers and one actor's most unprotected performance.
entertainment.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Scientists Built Living Microrobots That Repaired Spinal Cord Injuries in Mice. India Has One of the Highest Rates of Such Injuries in the World.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A team at ETH Zurich combined stem cells with magnetoelectric nanoparticles to create tiny machines that can be guided to injury sites and stimulate nerve regrowth. The study, published in Nature Materials, restored movement in paralysed mice within weeks.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Four-Week Yoga Programme Just Showed It Can Sharply Reduce Insomnia and Anxiety in Cancer Survivors. The Practice Was Born in India.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A large randomised trial presented at the 2026 ASCO meeting found that yoga significantly reduced fatigue, mood disturbance, and sleep problems after cancer treatment. For the diaspora community, the findings are both validation and vindication.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Daily Pill Just Doubled Survival for Pancreatic Cancer. For Diabetes-Prone South Asians, the Breakthrough Hits Close to Home.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Daraxonrasib, the first RAS inhibitor, cut the risk of death by 60 per cent in a 500-patient trial — the largest gain ever recorded for advanced pancreatic cancer.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians have 2-3x higher pancreatic cancer risk due to genetic predisposition to Type 2 diabetes. Dr. Shubham Pant, an Indian-origin oncologist at MD Anderson, co-led the trial.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Cigna Just Dropped GLP-1 Weight Loss Coverage for Its Own Employees. If You Are South Asian and on Wegovy, Read This.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: The insurer will stop covering Wegovy and Zepbound for weight loss on July 1. Other employers may follow — and the diaspora has the most to lose.
lifestyle-health.nri_angle: South Asians develop metabolic disease at lower BMI thresholds. Many tech professionals carry Cigna plans. Losing GLP-1 coverage forces a choice between cash-pay and medication discontinuation.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Scientists Calculated the Exact Sleep Window That Slows Ageing. It Is Not Eight Hours.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A study of half a million people published in Nature found that sleeping between 6.4 and 7.8 hours a night produced the youngest biological age across nearly every organ. For South Asians who sleep too little or too much, the findings are a wake-up call.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Weight-Loss Drugs Just Showed They May Cut Cancer Risk by Up to 71 Per Cent. South Asians Should Be Paying Close Attention.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Six studies presented at ASCO 2026 found GLP-1 medications linked to dramatically lower rates of pancreatic, lung, breast, and blood cancers. The implications for a community with among the world's highest diabetes rates are enormous.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Compound in Strawberries Just Showed It Can Reduce the Brain Proteins Behind Alzheimer's. The Catch Is in Your Genes.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Brain autopsies from 575 people in the Rush Memory and Aging Project found that high pelargonidin intake from berries was linked to fewer amyloid plaques and tau tangles — but only in people without the APOE ε4 risk gene.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Two-Year Calorie Restriction Trial Just Revealed Why You Age Faster Than You Should. The Answer Is in Your Immune System.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A landmark Nature Aging study found that cutting 14 per cent of daily calories deactivated complement proteins that drive chronic inflammation — the same proteins that run high in South Asians decades before heart disease strikes.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Personalised mRNA Vaccine Just Halved Melanoma Recurrence Over Five Years. Cancer Treatment May Never Be the Same.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Moderna and Merck's KEYNOTE-942 trial shows the vaccine kept 92 per cent of patients alive at the five-year mark, compared with 71 per cent on standard immunotherapy alone. South Asians, often diagnosed later, have the most to gain from a treatment that learns each tumour's fingerprint.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: A Harvard Study Found the Best Diet for Weight Management During Menopause. Indian Kitchens Already Follow Most of It.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: A 38,000-woman study in JAMA Network Open found that a planetary health diet cut obesity risk by 54 per cent during menopause. Dal, whole wheat roti, nuts, and mustard oil — staples of Indian cooking — are at the core of what researchers recommend.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Night Owls Are Not Just Tired. A New Study Says They Are Lonelier, and It Is Making Them Anxious.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Research presented at SLEEP 2026 finds that nocturnal loneliness is the key pathway linking late sleep patterns to higher anxiety — a finding that hits close to home for South Asians staying up to call family across time zones.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk

lifestyle-health.title: Insomnia Triples Breast Cancer Risk in Women Under 50. A New Study Just Made Sleep a Cancer Conversation.
lifestyle-health.excerpt: Research presented at ASCO 2026 found that women diagnosed with insomnia were three times more likely to develop breast cancer within five years. For South Asian women — who face unique sleep pressures — the findings demand attention.
lifestyle-health.author: Diaspora Desk
